findings.message: a3 says 'the other three end the hymn with verse 5' and cites vanivilas-1910-works-17, sringeri-shiva-panchakshara and stotranidhi-shiva-panchakshara. None of these three has an excerpt file in v6/sources/, and none of the citations carries a quote. The only support is text-report.md. Separately, the note calls all six witnesses 'printed texts', but text-report.md lists A (sanskritdocuments.org) and E (sringeri.net) as websites, so that wording goes further than the source.
findings.suggested_fix: Save short v6 excerpts for B, E and F that record the hymn ending after v5 with a colophon (or cite text-report.md as the locator). Change 'Three of the six printed texts compared' to 'Three of the six texts compared' (hi: keep 'छह पाठों').
